Company

Established in 1983, Amit Engineering Works is the only tamping machine spare parts manufacturer in India — a leading exporter, wholesaler, and supplier of spares and assemblies to Indian Railways.

With over 40 years of experience and the 720° Crystal Model approach, we deliver top-notch client satisfaction, innovative solutions, and unmatched sales support.

Overview

ISO 9001 certified since 1983. The only tamping machine spare parts manufacturer in India, providing every micro-assistance for spare parts and related services.

Mission

To provide the highest-quality end products through dedication, innovation, and integrity — adhering to environmental regulations and supporting growth of our people.

Vision

To be the best service provider delivering innovative, cost-effective solutions meeting international standards, helping all stakeholders grow through quality service.

Tungsten Carbide Tamping Tool — Specifications

  • Chromium Molybdenum / Nickel Chromium Molybdenum alloy steel
  • Minimum vibration frequency 35 Hz, squeeze pressure 120 kg/sq.cm
  • CNC-produced; full tungsten carbide on pad and wear areas; RDSO compliant
  • Saves minimum 30% cost; tool life up to 15× longer
  • Reduces transportation time and manpower by up to 20×
  • Compatible: 09/32 CSM, 09/16 CSM, 08/32U, 08/32, 07/16, 09-Dynamic, Duomatic, Unimate 3S & 4S, MFI

TCTT Benefits vs Ordinary Tamping Tools

  • Less inventory — fewer tool variants across machine types
  • Improves tamping quality and tamping bank life
  • Reduces costly machine downtime
  • Increases insertion count, performance, productivity & durability
  • Life up to 15 times longer than standard tools

Squeezing Cylinders — Specifications

  • IS: 2062-1992; tensile strength 410 MPa; elongation ≥ 23%
  • Golden yellow enamel paint (two coats); boiled linseed oil on functional surface
  • 09-CSM: 50% higher work capacity, non-synchronous uniform pressure, 35 Hz
  • 09-3X: 30–40% output increase; flexible single or three-sleeper tamping

Cutting Chain Assemblies — Specifications

  • Complete sets of 69 to 105 Nos. depending on machine
  • Available for: BCM RM 800, RM 74/76, RM 80, HOBCM, FRM 80 SBCM, Russian BCM 1400, GMEC QSM-400
  • Options: with carbide, without carbide, high-output versions
  • Excavating depth: up to 900mm (RM 76U) and 1150mm (RM 80U)
